title: Tim Burchett on the high rate of researchers disappearing

tellings.quote: He told the Daily Mail that the numbers seem very high in these certain areas of research.

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, in an episode about American scientists who have gone missing, cites Tim Burchett, a member of the US Congress. According to Michels, Burchett told the Daily Mail, a British newspaper, that the numbers seem very high in certain areas of research. Michels raises it because, if true, it would point to something unusual happening to people in those fields.
